card.name: Pugh in Child-Pugh liver grading
card.fires_on: The 'ugh' ending of 'Pugh' in 'Child-Pugh' (or 'Child Pugh') after 'P', in statements about hepatic impairment. It also fires weakly on a stray digit inside a journal page number in a citation.

modes.label: Child-Pugh class
modes.description: The 'ugh' piece of Pugh in the Child-Pugh liver-function score, just before a class letter or score.

modes.label: Citation digit
modes.description: A digit within a volume or page number in a journal reference.

card.plain: It marks the end of the name Child-Pugh when a label grades liver impairment as class A, B or C.
